2609.34764.title: WeaveData: A Multimodal Data Analysis System with Self-Critiquing and Self-Evolving LLM Plans
2609.34764.paper_summary: Multimodal data analysis, which answers questions over relational tables, text, and images, has attracted growing attention in the data management community. Large language models (LLMs) enable such analysis in natural language by generating analysis plans over relational and semantic operators. However, LLM-generated plans are error-prone: a plan may silently compute something other than what was asked, fail during execution, or return a result that misses the question. This paper presents WeaveData, a multimodal data analysis system with self-critiquing and self-evolving LLM plans. First, WeaveData generates a typed logical plan for each question and critiques it step by step before execution, and it checks the executed result against the question afterwards. Second, WeaveData evolves a plan that fails or misses the question: it diagnoses the failure with the actual data, reuses the results that remain valid, and accumulates planning experience for later questions. Third, WeaveData grounds planning in a metadata knowledge graph of all modalities, clarifies ambiguous questions with the user, and backs every model judgment with evidence in an interactive notebook. We demonstrate WeaveData on two public multimodal datasets.
2609.34764.paper_summary_zh: 多模態數據分析，旨在回答關於關聯表、文本和圖像的問題，已在數據管理社群中引起越來越多的關注。大型語言模型（LLMs）通過生成關聯和語義運算子的分析計劃，使這種分析能夠以自然語言進行。然而，LLM生成的計劃容易出錯：計劃可能默默計算出與所要求的不同內容、在執行過程中失敗，或返回一個未能解答問題的結果。本文介紹了WeaveData，一個具有自我批評和自我演化LLM計劃的多模態數據分析系統。首先，WeaveData為每個問題生成一個類型化的邏輯計劃，並在執行前逐步對其進行批評，然後在執行後檢查執行結果是否符合問題。其次，WeaveData對失敗或未能回答問題的計劃進行演化：它利用實際數據診斷失敗，重用仍然有效的結果，並為以後的問題累積規劃經驗。第三，WeaveData將規劃基於所有模態的元數據知識圖譜，與用戶澄清模糊問題，並在互動筆記本中用證據支持每個模型判斷。我們在兩個公共多模態數據集上展示了WeaveData。
